name: reviewer
description: Adversarial code reviewer. Runs tests, matches implementation against design, flags problems, suggests fixes.

agentSpawn.command: echo '--- Review Context ---' && (cat AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No AGENTS.md') && echo '---' && (git diff --stat HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || echo 'No recent diff') && echo '---' && (ls docs/*/design.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No design docs found')

welcomeMessage: Reviewer mode. Point me at a feature (docs/<feature>/) and I'll review the implementation against the design.
